info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Fitness Memberships Cancel-v5-spec
info.description: This API endpoint facilitates the cancellation of fitness memberships, enabling users to easily manage their subscriptions. The operation allows consumers, such as gym administrators or members, to process cancellation requests efficiently. It serves as a critical resource for maintaining accurate membership records and enhancing customer satisfaction by offering a straightforward cancellation process. Businesses can ensure a smooth transition for users looking to discontinue their services directly through the API.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel their existing membership. Upon successful cancellation, the membership will be marked as inactive, and any associated benefits will be terminated.

requestBody.description: Request body for canceling a membership. This request should contain appropriate identifiers and reasons for cancellation to process the request accurately.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelRequest.description: A request body for cancelling a membership operation.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelResponse_2.title: Membership Cancel Response

state.description: Current state of the membership post-cancellation.
